milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia_pressure_plate is at spawn-relative (4, 0, -6), ~7.2 blocks from spawn. max_distance=8 ensures the player actually navigated toward the right path rather than just spawning facing the correct direction. facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual identification of the pressure plate on the ground.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue_ice cluster center is at spawn-relative (-5, 0, -5), ~7.1 blocks from spawn. max_distance=8 ensures intentional navigation to the left path. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the distinctive bright blue ice blocks.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_button drops the birch_button item into the player's inventory. The button is wall-mounted at (5, 1, -6) on oak_planks. A wooden_axe is provided but any tool or bare hands can break it. inventory_has is the most reliable verification that the block was actually mined and collected, not just approached.

Uses position_near_with_facing because interacting with a lectern requires being within Minecraft's interaction range (~4.5 blocks) and facing it. The lectern is at spawn-relative (-7, 1, -5) on an oak_planks pedestal with has_book=true. max_distance=4 ensures the player is within interaction range, and facing_tolerance=45 confirms intentional orientation toward the lectern. This is the best available proxy since lectern GUI interaction doesn't produce a trackable use_item event.
